The snake episodes are\nsimulated here by the SNAKE-01 to SNAKE-06 rules on a 10 x 10 grid (actions: 0 straight, 1 left,\n2 right; headings up, right, down, left), so steps, observations, frames and scores agree.\nThe corridor check world uses action 0 = left, 1 = right (AD-09).\n\"\"\"\n\nimport json\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nOUT = Path(__file__).parent\n\n\ndef write(folder, rel, data):\n    path = OUT / folder / rel\n    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    path.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=1) + \"\\n\")\n\n\n# ------------------------------------------------------------------ schemas (JSON Schema)\nNUM = {\"type\": \"number\"}\nINT = {\"type\": \"integer\"}\nNAT = {\"type\": \"integer\", \"minimum\": 0}\nPOS = {\"type\": \"integer\", \"minimum\": 1}\nSTR = {\"type\": \"string\"}\nBOOL = {\"type\": \"boolean\"}\nP = {\"type\": \"number\", \"minimum\": 0, \"maximum\": 1}\nDIRECTION = {\"enum\": [\"higher\", \"lower\"]}\n\n\ndef obj(props):\n    return {\n        \"type\": \"object\",\n        \"properties\": props,\n        \"required\": list(props),\n        \"additionalProperties\": False,\n    }\n\n\ndef arr(items, n=None):\n    d = {\"type\": \"array\", \"items\": items}\n    if n is not None:\n        d[\"minItems\"] = d[\"maxItems\"] = n\n    return d\n\n\ndef ref(name):\n    return {\"$ref\": f\"#/$defs/{name}\"}\n\n\ndef nullable(s):\n    return {\"anyOf\": [s, {\"type\": \"null\"}]}\n\n\ndef mapping(values):\n    return {\"type\": \"object\", \"additionalProperties\": values}\n\n\nDEFS = {\n    \"ActionSpace\": {\n        \"anyOf\": [\n            obj({\"kind\": {\"const\": \"discrete\"}, \"n\": POS}),\n            obj({\"kind\": {\"const\": \"box\"}, \"dims\": POS, \"low\": NUM, \"high\": NUM}),\n        ]\n    },\n    \"TeamSpec\": obj({\"name\": STR, \"agents\": arr(NAT), \"score_name\": STR, \"direction\": DIRECTION}),\n    \"MeasureSpec\": obj({\"name\": STR, \"team\": STR, \"direction\": DIRECTION}),\n    \"WorldSpec\": obj({\n        \"world\": STR,\n        \"variant\": STR,\n        \"agents\": arr(STR),\n        \"teams\": arr(ref(\"TeamSpec\")),\n        \"obs_len\": POS,\n        \"action\": ref(\"ActionSpace\"),\n        \"max_steps\": POS,\n        \"measures\": arr(ref(\"MeasureSpec\")),\n        \"sight\": nullable(NUM),\n    }),\n    \"Step\": obj({\n        \"obs\": arr(arr(NUM)),\n        \"rewards\": arr(NUM),\n        \"active\": arr(BOOL),\n        \"done\": BOOL,\n        \"truncated\": BOOL,\n    }),\n    \"EpisodeResult\": obj({\n        \"seed\": INT,\n        \"length\": NAT,\n        \"scores\": mapping(NUM),\n        \"team_rewards\": mapping(NUM),\n        \"measures\": mapping(NUM),\n    }),\n    \"Drawable\": obj({\n        \"kind\": STR,\n        \"x\": NUM,\n        \"y\": NUM,\n        \"size\": NUM,\n        \"team\": nullable(STR),\n        \"agent\": nullable(NAT),\n    }),\n    \"DrawState\": obj({\"width\": NUM, \"height\": NUM, \"objects\": arr(ref(\"Drawable\"))}),\n    \"Frame\": obj({\n        \"step\": NAT,\n        \"draw\": ref(\"DrawState\"),\n        \"scores\": mapping(NUM),\n        \"rewards\": arr(NUM),\n    }),\n    \"Episode\": obj({\n        \"result\": ref(\"EpisodeResult\"),\n        \"frames\": nullable(arr(ref(\"Frame\"))),\n        \"hit_step_limit\": BOOL,\n    }),\n    \"Output\": obj({\n        \"path\": STR,\n        \"kind\": {\"enum\": [\"chart\", \"video\", \"writeup\"]},\n        \"made_from\": arr(STR),\n    }),\n    \"Settings\": mapping({\"type\": [\"integer\", \"number\", \"string\", \"boolean\"]}),\n    \"MethodConfig\": obj({\"method\": {\"enum\": [\"dqn\", \"ppo\"]}, \"settings\": ref(\"Settings\")}),\n    \"RunConfig\": obj({\n        \"name\": STR,\n        \"world\": STR,\n        \"variant\": STR,\n        \"methods\": mapping(ref(\"MethodConfig\")),\n        \"seed\": NAT,\n        \"budget\": POS,\n        \"check_settings\": mapping(ref(\"Settings\")),\n        \"device\": STR,\n    }),\n    \"BaselineMeans\": obj({\n        \"world\": STR,\n        \"variant\": STR,\n        \"random\": mapping(NUM),\n        \"rule\": mapping(NUM),\n    }),\n    \"Transition\": obj({\n        \"obs\": arr(arr(NUM)),\n        \"actions\": arr({\"anyOf\": [INT, arr(NUM)]}),\n        \"rewards\": arr(NUM),\n        \"next_obs\": arr(arr(NUM)),\n        \"done\": BOOL,\n        \"truncated\": BOOL,\n        \"active\": arr(BOOL),\n    }),\n    \"CheckResult\": obj({\"method\": STR, \"world\": STR, \"agreement\": P, \"passed\": BOOL}),\n    \"Failure\": obj({\"step\": NAT, \"value\": NUM, \"checkpoint\": STR}),\n    \"RunRecord\": obj({\n        \"config\": ref(\"RunConfig\"),\n        \"spec\": ref(\"WorldSpec\"),\n        \"started\": STR,\n        \"ended\": nullable(STR),\n        \"status\": {\"enum\": [\"running\", \"finished\", \"incomplete\", \"failed\"]},\n        \"failure\": nullable(ref(\"Failure\")),\n        \"path\": STR,\n    }),\n    \"EvalPoint\": obj({\"step\": NAT, \"scores\": mapping(NUM), \"measures\": mapping(NUM)}),\n    \"Checkpoint\": obj({\n        \"run\": STR,\n        \"pct\": {\"enum\": list(range(0, 101, 10))},\n        \"step\": NAT,\n        \"spec\": ref(\"WorldSpec\"),\n        \"methods\": mapping(ref(\"MethodConfig\")),\n        \"state\": mapping({\"type\": \"object\"}),\n        \"path\": STR,\n    }),\n    \"Progress\": obj({\n        \"step\": NAT,\n        \"budget\": POS,\n        \"latest\": nullable(ref(\"EvalPoint\")),\n        \"elapsed\": {\"type\": \"number\", \"minimum\": 0},\n        \"status\": STR,\n    }),\n    \"Comparison\": obj({\n        \"baseline\": {\"enum\": [\"random\", \"rule\"]},\n        \"team\": STR,\n        \"learned_mean\": NUM,\n        \"baseline_mean\": NUM,\n        \"difference\": NUM,\n        \"p_raw\": P,\n        \"p_holm\": P,\n        \"rejected\": BOOL,\n    }),\n    \"Verdict\": obj({\"beats_baselines\": BOOL, \"failing_runs\": arr(STR), \"runs_needed\": NAT}),\n    \"Summary\": obj({\n        \"world\": STR,\n        \"variant\": STR,\n        \"team\": STR,\n        \"runs\": arr(STR),\n        \"learned_mean\": NUM,\n        \"learned_range\": arr(NUM, 2),\n        \"run_means\": mapping(NUM),\n        \"random_mean\": NUM,\n        \"rule_mean\": NUM,\n        \"comparisons\": arr(ref(\"Comparison\")),\n        \"verdict\": ref(\"Verdict\"),\n        \"collapse\": nullable(NAT),\n    }),\n}\n\n\ndef refs(node, found):\n    if isinstance(node, dict):\n        if \"$ref\" in node:\n            name = node[\"$ref\"].rsplit(\"/\", 1)[1]\n            if name not in found:\n                found.add(name)\n                refs(DEFS[name], found)\n        for value in node.values():\n            refs(value, found)\n    elif isinstance(node, list):\n        for value in node:\n            refs(value, found)\n\n\ndef schema(folder, type_name):\n    found = {type_name}\n    refs(DEFS[type_name], found)\n    write(\n        folder,\n        \"schema.json\",\n        {\n            \"$schema\": \"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema\",\n            \"title\": folder,\n            \"$ref\": f\"#/$defs/{type_name}\",\n            \"$defs\": {name: DEFS[name] for name in sorted(found)},\n        },\n    )\n\n\n# ------------------------------------------------------------------ specs\ndef team(name, agents, score, direction):\n    return {\"name\": name, \"agents\": agents, \"score_name\": score, \"direction\": direction}\n\n\ndef snake_spec(max_steps=1000):\n    return {\n        \"world\": \"snake\",\n        \"variant\": \"default\",\n        \"agents\": [\"snake\"],\n        \"teams\": [team(\"snake\", [0], \"food eaten\", \"higher\")],\n        \"obs_len\": 12,\n        \"action\": {\"kind\": \"discrete\", \"n\": 3},\n        \"max_steps\": max_steps,\n        \"measures\": [],\n        \"sight\": None,\n    }\n\n\nBOX2 = {\"kind\": \"box\", \"dims\": 2, \"low\": -1.0, \"high\": 1.0}\nFISH_LOCAL = {\n    \"world\": \"fish\",\n    \"variant\": \"local\",\n    \"agents\": [f\"fish-{i}\" for i in range(8)],\n    \"teams\": [team(\"fish\", list(range(8)), \"hits per fish\", \"lower\")],\n    \"obs_len\": 44,\n    \"action\": BOX2,\n    \"max_steps\": 1000,\n    \"measures\": [],\n    \"sight\": 3.0,\n}\nPREY_OBS = 40\nPREY = {\n    \"world\": \"prey\",\n    \"variant\": \"default\",\n    \"agents\": [*(f\"prey-{i}\" for i in range(6)), \"predator-0\", \"predator-1\"],\n    \"teams\": [\n        team(\"prey\", list(range(6)), \"pellets per prey\", \"higher\"),\n        team(\"predator\", [6, 7], \"prey caught\", \"higher\"),\n    ],\n    \"obs_len\": PREY_OBS,\n    \"action\": BOX2,\n    \"max_steps\": 1000,\n    \"measures\": [{\"name\": \"survivors\", \"team\": \"prey\", \"direction\": \"higher\"}],\n    \"sight\": 4.0,\n}\nCORRIDOR_SPEC = {\n    \"world\": \"check-discrete\",\n    \"variant\": \"default\",\n    \"agents\": [\"agent\"],\n    \"teams\": [team(\"agent\", [0], \"return\", \"higher\")],\n    \"obs_len\": 6,\n    \"action\": {\"kind\": \"discrete\", \"n\": 2},\n    \"max_steps\": 50,\n    \"measures\": [],\n    \"sight\": None,\n}\nPOINT_SPEC = {\n    **CORRIDOR_SPEC,\n    \"world\": \"check-continuous\",\n    \"obs_len\": 1,\n    \"action\": {\"kind\": \"box\", \"dims\": 1, \"low\": -1.0, \"high\": 1.0},\n    \"max_steps\": 20,\n}\n\n\n# ------------------------------------------------------------------ snake simulation\nHEADINGS = [(0, -1), (1, 0), (0, 1), (-1, 0)]  # up, right, down, left\nTURNS = {0: 0, 1: -1, 2: 1}  # straight, left, right\n\n\ndef blocked(cell, body):\n    x, y = cell\n    return not (0 <= x < 10 and 0 <= y < 10) or cell in body[:-1]\n\n\ndef snake_obs(body, heading, food):\n    \"\"\"Danger straight, left, right; heading one-hot; food up, right, down, left; length.\"\"\"\n    head = body[0]\n\n    def danger(h):\n        dx, dy = HEADINGS[h % 4]\n        return float(blocked((head[0] + dx, head[1] + dy), body))\n\n    fx, fy = food[0] - head[0], food[1] - head[1]\n    return [\n        danger(heading),\n        danger(heading - 1),\n        danger(heading + 1),\n        *[float(i == heading) for i in range(4)],\n        float(fy < 0),\n        float(fx > 0),\n        float(fy > 0),\n        float(fx < 0),\n        float(len(body)),\n    ]\n\n\ndef cell(kind, x, y, team_name, agent):\n    return {\n        \"kind\": kind,\n        \"x\": float(x),\n        \"y\": float(y),\n        \"size\": 1.0,\n        \"team\": team_name,\n        \"agent\": agent,\n    }\n\n\ndef snake_draw(body, food):\n    head = [cell(\"snake-head\", *body[0], \"snake\", 0)]\n    rest = [cell(\"snake-body\", x, y, \"snake\", None) for x, y in body[1:]]\n    return {\n        \"width\": 10.0,\n        \"height\": 10.0,\n        \"objects\": [*head, *rest, cell(\"food\", *food, None, None)],\n    }\n\n\ndef snake_entry(seed, state, actions_taken, reward, length, truncated):\n    body, heading, food, eaten, total = state\n    return {\n        \"actions\": actions_taken,\n        \"step\": {\n            \"obs\": [snake_obs(body, heading, food)],\n            \"rewards\": [reward],\n            \"active\": [True],\n            \"done\": truncated,\n            \"truncated\": truncated,\n        },\n        \"draw\": snake_draw(body, food),\n        \"result\": {\n            \"seed\": seed,\n            \"length\": length,\n            \"scores\": {\"snake\": float(eaten)},\n            \"team_rewards\": {\"snake\": total},\n            \"measures\": {},\n        },\n    }\n\n\ndef snake_episode(seed, foods, actions, max_steps):\n    \"\"\"Index i: the Step, DrawState and running EpisodeResult after i steps from the centre.\"\"\"\n    body, heading, foods = [(5, 5), (5, 6), (5, 7)], 0, list(foods)\n    food, eaten, total = foods.pop(0), 0, 0.0\n    out = [snake_entry(seed, (body, heading, food, eaten, total), None, 0.0, 0, False)]\n    for i, action in enumerate(actions, start=1):\n        heading = (heading + TURNS[action]) % 4\n        head = (body[0][0] + HEADINGS[heading][0], body[0][1] + HEADINGS[heading][1])\n        assert not blocked(head, body)\n        body.insert(0, head)\n        reward = float(head == food)\n        if reward:\n            eaten, food = eaten + 1, foods.pop(0)\n        else:\n            body.pop()\n        total += reward\n        state = (body, heading, food, eaten, total)\n        out.append(snake_entry(seed, state, [action], reward, i, i == max_steps))\n    return out\n\n\nEP42 = snake_episode(42, [(8, 4), (2, 7)], [0, 2, 0, 0, 2], max_steps=5)\nEP7 = snake_episode(7, [(5, 3), (1, 1)], [0, 0, 0], max_steps=3)\n\n\ndef frames(episode):\n    return [\n        {\n            \"step\": i,\n            \"draw\": entry[\"draw\"],\n            \"scores\": entry[\"result\"][\"scores\"],\n            \"rewards\": entry[\"step\"][\"rewards\"],\n        }\n        for i, entry in enumerate(episode)\n    ]\n\n\n# ------------------------------------------------------------------ check worlds\ndef corridor_entry(seed, actions_taken, reward, length, state, total):\n    obs = [float(i == state) for i in range(6)]\n    marker = {\"kind\": \"agent\", \"x\": float(state + 1), \"y\": 0.0, \"size\": 1.0, \"team\": \"agent\",\n              \"agent\": 0}  # fmt: skip\n    return {\n        \"actions\": actions_taken,\n        \"step\": {\n            \"obs\": [obs],\n            \"rewards\": [reward],\n            \"active\": [True],\n            \"done\": state in {-1, 6},\n            \"truncated\": False,\n        },\n        \"draw\": {\n            \"width\": 8.0,\n            \"height\": 1.0,\n            \"objects\": [cell(\"exit\", 0, 0, None, None), cell(\"exit\", 7, 0, None, None), marker],\n        },\n        \"result\": {\n            \"seed\": seed,\n            \"length\": length,\n            \"scores\": {\"agent\": total},\n            \"team_rewards\": {\"agent\": total},\n            \"measures\": {},\n        },\n    }\n\n\ndef corridor_episode(seed, start, actions):\n    \"\"\"States 0-5; leaving left of 0 pays 0.8, right of 5 pays 1.0 (AD-09).\"\"\"\n    state, total = start, 0.0\n    out = [corridor_entry(seed, None, 0.0, 0, state, total)]\n    for i, action in enumerate(actions, start=1):\n        state += 1 if action == 1 else -1\n        reward = {6: 1.0, -1: 0.8}.get(state, 0.0)\n        total += reward\n        out.append(corridor_entry(seed, [action], reward, i, state, total))\n    return out\n\n\nCORRIDOR = corridor_episode(0, 2, [1, 1, 1, 1])\nCORRIDOR3 = corridor_episode(1, 3, [1, 1, 1])\n\n\ndef point_entry(seed, actions_taken, reward, length, x, total):\n    return {\n        \"actions\": actions_taken,\n        \"step\": {\n            \"obs\": [[x]],\n            \"rewards\": [reward],\n            \"active\": [True],\n            \"done\": length > 0 and abs(x) < 0.05,\n            \"truncated\": False,\n        },\n        \"draw\": {\n            \"width\": 2.0,\n            \"height\": 1.0,\n            \"objects\": [\n                {\"kind\": \"target\", \"x\": 1.0, \"y\": 0.5, \"size\": 0.1, \"team\": None, \"agent\": None},\n                {\"kind\": \"agent\", \"x\": round(x + 1.0, 6), \"y\": 0.5, \"size\": 0.1,\n                 \"team\": \"agent\", \"agent\": 0},\n            ],  # fmt: skip\n        },\n        \"result\": {\n            \"seed\": seed,\n            \"length\": length,\n            \"scores\": {\"agent\": total},\n            \"team_rewards\": {\"agent\": total},\n            \"measures\": {},\n        },\n    }\n\n\ndef point_episode(seed, start, pushes):\n    \"\"\"A 1-D point moving 0.2 per unit push, rewarded -|x|; reaching the target ends it.\"\"\"\n    x, total = start, 0.0\n    out = [point_entry(seed, None, 0.0, 0, x, total)]\n    for i, push in enumerate(pushes, start=1):\n        x = round(x + 0.2 * push, 6)\n        reward = round(-abs(x), 6)\n        total = round(total + reward, 6)\n        out.append(point_entry(seed, [[float(push)]], reward, i, x, total))\n    return out\n\n\nPOINT = point_episode(0, 0.6, [-1, -1, -1])\n\n# ------------------------------------------------------------------ configs and runs\nDQN_DEFAULTS = {\n    \"lr\": 0.001,\n    \"gamma\": 0.99,\n    \"hidden\": 64,\n    \"epsilon_start\": 1.0,\n    \"epsilon_end\": 0.05,\n    \"epsilon_decay_steps\": 10000,\n}\nPPO_SETTINGS = {\"lr\": 0.0001, \"gamma\": 0.99, \"hidden\": 64, \"rollout_steps\": 2048}\nDQN = {\"method\": \"dqn\", \"settings\": DQN_DEFAULTS}\nSTARTED = \"2026-10-17T09:00:00+00:00\"\nENDED = \"2026-10-17T09:41:00+00:00\"\n\n\ndef snake_config(seed, budget=2000):\n    return {\n        \"name\": f\"snake-default-s{seed}\",\n        \"world\": \"snake\",\n        \"variant\": \"default\",\n        \"methods\": {\"snake\": DQN},\n        \"seed\": seed,\n        \"budget\": budget,\n        \"check_settings\": {\"dqn\": {\"epsilon_decay_steps\": 500}},\n        \"device\": \"cpu\",\n    }\n\n\nPREY_CONFIG = {\n    \"name\": \"prey-default-s1\",\n    \"world\": \"prey\",\n    \"variant\": \"default\",\n    \"methods\": {\n        \"prey\": {\"method\": \"ppo\", \"settings\": PPO_SETTINGS},\n        \"predator\": {\"method\": \"ppo\", \"settings\": {**PPO_SETTINGS, \"lr\": 0.0003}},\n    },\n    \"seed\": 1,\n    \"budget\": 200000,\n    \"check_settings\": {\"ppo\": {\"rollout_steps\": 256}},\n    \"device\": \"cpu\",\n}\n\n\ndef run_folder(name):\n    return f\"runs/snake/default/{name}\"\n\n\ndef eval_points(seed):\n    return [\n        {\"step\": 100 * k, \"scores\": {\"snake\": round((8 + 0.3 * seed) * k / 20, 4)}, \"measures\": {}}\n        for k in range(21)\n    ]\n\n\ndef episodes(seed):\n    return [\n        {\n            \"seed\": 1000 * seed + i,\n            \"length\": n,\n            \"scores\": {\"snake\": float(i + seed // 2)},\n            \"team_rewards\": {\"snake\": float(i + seed // 2) - 1.0},\n            \"measures\": {},\n        }\n        for i, n in enumerate([37, 52, 61, 88, 140, 212])\n    ]\n\n\ndef checkpoint(name, pct, budget):\n    return {\n        \"run\": name,\n        \"pct\": pct,\n        \"step\": budget * pct // 100,\n        \"spec\": snake_spec(),\n        \"methods\": {\"snake\": DQN},\n        \"state\": {\"snake\": {\"observed\": budget * pct // 100}},\n        \"path\": f\"{run_folder(name)}/checkpoints/ckpt_{pct}.pt\",\n    }\n\n\ndef record(seed, status, ended, budget=2000):\n    return {\n        \"config\": snake_config(seed, budget),\n        \"spec\": snake_spec(),\n        \"started\": STARTED,\n        \"ended\": ended,\n        \"status\": status,\n        \"failure\": None,\n        \"path\": run_folder(f\"snake-default-s{seed}\"),\n    }\n\n\ndef run_recording(seed, status=\"finished\"):\n    \"\"\"A 2,000-step snake run folder: 3 checkpoints when finished, 8 eval points when not.\"\"\"\n    name = f\"snake-default-s{seed}\"\n    finished = status == \"finished\"\n    return {\n        \"record\": record(seed, status, ENDED if finished else None),\n        \"episodes\": episodes(seed) if finished else episodes(seed)[:2],\n        \"evals\": eval_points(seed) if finished else eval_points(seed)[:8],\n        \"checkpoints\": [checkpoint(name, pct, 2000) for pct in ([0, 50, 100] if finished else [0])],\n    }\n\n\ndef run_writer_calls(rec):\n    \"\"\"The writes of a finished 3-checkpoint run, in the order a training loop makes them.\"\"\"\n    ckpt = [\n        {\"call\": \"checkpoint\", \"pct\": c[\"pct\"], \"step\": c[\"step\"], \"state\": c[\"state\"],\n         \"returns\": c}\n        for c in rec[\"checkpoints\"]\n    ]  # fmt: skip\n    evals = [{\"call\": \"eval\", \"point\": p} for p in rec[\"evals\"]]\n    eps = [{\"call\": \"episode\", \"result\": e} for e in rec[\"episodes\"]]\n    close = {\"call\": \"close\", \"status\": \"finished\", \"failure\": None, \"returns\": rec[\"record\"]}\n    return [\n        ckpt[0], evals[0], *eps[:3], *evals[1:11], ckpt[1], *eps[3:], *evals[11:], ckpt[2], close\n    ]  # fmt: skip\n\n\n# ------------------------------------------------------------------ core\ndef core_types():\n    schema(\"core.ActionSpace\", \"ActionSpace\")\n """Validate contract JSON against its schema: the JSON Schema subset the contract folders use.

Supported: `$ref` (local `#/...` or a file beside the schema), `type`, `const`, `enum`, `anyOf`,
`properties`, `required`, `additionalProperties`, `items`, `minItems`, `maxItems`, `minimum`,
`maximum`. Booleans are never numbers, as in JSON Schema.
"""

import json
from functools import cache
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

TYPES = {
    "object": lambda v: isinstance(v, dict),
    "array": lambda v: isinstance(v, list),
    "string": lambda v: isinstance(v, str),
    "boolean": lambda v: isinstance(v, bool),
    "null": lambda v: v is None,
    "integer": lambda v: isinstance(v, int) and not isinstance(v, bool),
    "number": lambda v: isinstance(v, int | float) and not isinstance(v, bool),
}


def errors(instance: Any, schema_path: Path) -> list[str]:
    """Every way `instance` breaks the schema at `schema_path`; empty when it validates."""
    doc = _read(str(schema_path))
    return _errors(instance, doc, doc, schema_path.parent, "$")


@cache
def _read(path: str) -> Any:
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def _resolve(ref: str, doc: Any, base: Path) -> tuple[Any, Any, Path]:
    file, _, pointer = ref.partition("#")
    if file:
        path = (base / file).resolve()
        doc, base = _read(str(path)), path.parent
    node = doc
    for part in filter(None, pointer.split("/")):
        node = node[part]
    return node, doc, base


def _same(value: Any, expected: Any) -> bool:
    return isinstance(value, bool) == isinstance(expected, bool) and value == expected


def _errors(value: Any, schema: Any, doc: Any, base: Path, where: str) -> list[str]:
    if "$ref" in schema:
        target, doc, base = _resolve(schema["$ref"], doc, base)
        return _errors(value, target, doc, base, where)
    if "anyOf" in schema:
        options = [_errors(value, option, doc, base, where) for option in schema["anyOf"]]
        return [] if any(not found for found in options) else [f"{where}: matches no anyOf"]
    kinds = schema.get("type")
    kinds = [kinds] if isinstance(kinds, str) else kinds
    if kinds and not any(TYPES[kind](value) for kind in kinds):
        return [f"{where}: {value!r} is not {' or '.join(kinds)}"]
    found = _value_errors(value, schema, where)
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        found += _object_errors(value, schema, doc, base, where)
    if isinstance(value, list):
        found += _array_errors(value, schema, doc, base, where)
    return found


def _value_errors(value: Any, schema: Any, where: str) -> list[str]:
    found = []
    if "const" in schema and not _same(value, schema["const"]):
        found.append(f"{where}: {value!r} is not {schema['const']!r}")
    if "enum" in schema and not any(_same(value, option) for option in schema["enum"]):
        found.append(f"{where}: {value!r} is not one of {schema['enum']}")
    if TYPES["number"](value):
        if "minimum" in schema and value < schema["minimum"]:
            found.append(f"{where}: {value} is below {schema['minimum']}")
        if "maximum" in schema and value > schema["maximum"]:
            found.append(f"{where}: {value} is above {schema['maximum']}")
    return found


def _object_errors(value: dict, schema: Any, doc: Any, base: Path, where: str) -> list[str]:
    found = [f"{where}: missing {key!r}" for key in schema.get("required", []) if key not in value]
    properties = schema.get("properties", {})
    extra = schema.get("additionalProperties", True)
    for key, item in value.items():
        if key in properties:
            found += _errors(item, properties[key], doc, base, f"{where}.{key}")
        elif extra is False:
            found.append(f"{where}: unexpected {key!r}")
        elif isinstance(extra, dict):
            found += _errors(item, extra, doc, base, f"{where}.{key}")
    return found


def _array_errors(value: list, schema: Any, doc: Any, base: Path, where: str) -> list[str]:
    found = []
    if len(value) < schema.get("minItems", 0):
        found.append(f"{where}: fewer than {schema['minItems']} items")
    if "maxItems" in schema and len(value) > schema["maxItems"]:
        found.append(f"{where}: more than {schema['maxItems']} items")
    if "items" in schema:
        for i, item in enumerate(value):
            found += _errors(item, schema["items"], doc, base, f"{where}[{i}]")
    return found

schema.get(\"properties\", {})\n    extra = schema.get(\"additionalProperties\", True)\n    for key, item in value.items():\n        if key in properties:\n            found += _errors(item, properties[key], doc, base, f\"{where}.{key}\")\n        elif extra is False:\n            found.append(f\"{where}: unexpected {key!r}\")\n        elif isinstance(extra, dict):\n            found += _errors(item, extra, doc, base, f\"{where}.{key}\")\n    return found\n\n\ndef _array_errors(value: list, schema: Any, doc: Any, base: Path, where: str) -> list[str]:\n    found = []\n    if len(value) < schema.get(\"minItems\", 0):\n        found.append(f\"{where}: fewer than {schema['minItems']} items\")\n    if \"maxItems\" in schema and len(value) > schema[\"maxItems\"]:\n        found.append(f\"{where}: more than {schema['maxItems']} items\")\n    if \"items\" in schema:\n        for i, item in enumerate(value):\n            found += _errors(item, schema[\"items\"], doc, base, f\"{where}[{i}]\")\n    return found\n"

"""Load the frozen contract fixtures: samples, recordings, and the doubles and fakes beside them.

Every test imports this the same way, from any folder under `tests/`:

    from tests.contracts import decode, load

    spec = decode.world_spec(load.sample("core.WorldSpec", "snake_default"))
    world = load.module("core.World", "double").recorded_world()
    configs = load.module("train.load_run_configs", "fake").load_run_configs(path, [1, 2])

A folder is `tests/contracts/<component>.<Symbol>/`: `schema.json` and `samples/<case>.json` for a
type, a recording and `double.py` for a Protocol or class, `fake.py` for a boundary function.
"""

import importlib.util
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from types import ModuleType
from typing import Any

CONTRACTS = Path(__file__).parent


def folder(symbol: str) -> Path:
    """The contract folder of `symbol`, e.g. `core.WorldSpec`."""
    path = CONTRACTS / symbol
    if not path.is_dir():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"no contract folder for {symbol!r}")
    return path


def read(path: Path) -> Any:
    return json.loads(path.read_text())


def sample(symbol: str, case: str) -> Any:
    """The JSON of one named sample of a type."""
    return read(folder(symbol) / "samples" / f"{case}.json")


def samples(symbol: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Every sample of a type, by case name."""
    return {path.stem: read(path) for path in sorted((folder(symbol) / "samples").glob("*.json"))}


def recording(symbol: str, name: str = "recording") -> Any:
    """A recording a double replays."""
    return read(folder(symbol) / f"{name}.json")


def module(symbol: str, name: str) -> ModuleType:
    """The `double` or `fake` module of a contract folder, loaded once."""
    key = f"contracts_{symbol.replace('.', '_')}_{name}"
    if key not in sys.modules:
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(key, folder(symbol) / f"{name}.py")
        if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
            raise ImportError(f"cannot load {name}.py of {symbol}")
        loaded = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        sys.modules[key] = loaded
        spec.loader.exec_module(loaded)
    return sys.modules[key]

"""Build the contract types from their JSON (the shape `schema_defs.json` declares).

Arrays become NumPy arrays (observations and rewards float32, masks bool); paths become `Path`,
times `datetime` and elapsed seconds `timedelta`.
"""

from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import numpy as np

from rllab.baselines import BaselineMeans
from rllab.core import (
    ActionSpace,
    Array,
    Box,
    Discrete,
    Drawable,
    DrawState,
    Episode,
    EpisodeResult,
    Frame,
    MeasureSpec,
    MethodConfig,
    Output,
    RunConfig,
    Step,
    TeamSpec,
    WorldSpec,
)
from rllab.evaluate import Comparison, Summary, Verdict
from rllab.methods import Transition
from rllab.runlog import Checkpoint, EvalPoint, Failure, Progress, RunRecord
from rllab.train import CheckResult

Json = dict[str, Any]


def floats(rows: Any) -> Array:
    return np.asarray(rows, dtype=np.float32)


def actions(rows: Any) -> Array:
    """Discrete actions as int64, `Box` actions as float32 rows."""
    array = np.asarray(rows)
    return array.astype(np.float32) if array.dtype.kind == "f" else array.astype(np.int64)


def action_space(d: Json) -> ActionSpace:
    if d["kind"] == "discrete":
        return Discrete(d["n"])
    return Box(d["dims"], d["low"], d["high"])


def team_spec(d: Json) -> TeamSpec:
    return TeamSpec(d["name"], tuple(d["agents"]), d["score_name"], d["direction"])


def measure_spec(d: Json) -> MeasureSpec:
    return MeasureSpec(d["name"], d["team"], d["direction"])


def world_spec(d: Json) -> WorldSpec:
    return WorldSpec(
        world=d["world"],
        variant=d["variant"],
        agents=tuple(d["agents"]),
        teams=tuple(team_spec(t) for t in d["teams"]),
        obs_len=d["obs_len"],
        action=action_space(d["action"]),
        max_steps=d["max_steps"],
        measures=tuple(measure_spec(m) for m in d["measures"]),
        sight=d["sight"],
    )


def step(d: Json) -> Step:
    return Step(
        obs=floats(d["obs"]),
        rewards=floats(d["rewards"]),
        active=np.asarray(d["active"], dtype=bool),
        done=d["done"],
        truncated=d["truncated"],
    )


def episode_result(d: Json) -> EpisodeResult:
    return EpisodeResult(
        seed=d["seed"],
        length=d["length"],
        scores=dict(d["scores"]),
        team_rewards=dict(d["team_rewards"]),
        measures=dict(d["measures"]),
    )


def drawable(d: Json) -> Drawable:
    return Drawable(d["kind"], d["x"], d["y"], d["size"], d["team"], d["agent"])


def draw_state(d: Json) -> DrawState:
    return DrawState(d["width"], d["height"], tuple(drawable(o) for o in d["objects"]))


def frame(d: Json) -> Frame:
    return Frame(d["step"], draw_state(d["draw"]), dict(d["scores"]), floats(d["rewards"]))


def episode(d: Json) -> Episode:
    frames = None if d["frames"] is None else tuple(frame(f) for f in d["frames"])
    return Episode(episode_result(d["result"]), frames, d["hit_step_limit"])


def output(d: Json) -> Output:
    return Output(Path(d["path"]), d["kind"], tuple(d["made_from"]))


def method_config(d: Json) -> MethodConfig:
    return MethodConfig(d["method"], dict(d["settings"]))


def run_config(d: Json) -> RunConfig:
    return RunConfig(
        name=d["name"],
        world=d["world"],
        variant=d["variant"],
        methods={team: method_config(m) for team, m in d["methods"].items()},
        seed=d["seed"],
        budget=d["budget"],
        check_settings={method: dict(s) for method, s in d["check_settings"].items()},
        device=d["device"],
    )


def seeds(d: list[int]) -> tuple[int, ...]:
    return tuple(d)


def baseline_means(d: Json) -> BaselineMeans:
    return BaselineMeans(d["world"], d["variant"], dict(d["random"]), dict(d["rule"]))


def transition(d: Json) -> Transition:
    return Transition(
        obs=floats(d["obs"]),
        actions=actions(d["actions"]),
        rewards=floats(d["rewards"]),
        next_obs=floats(d["next_obs"]),
        done=d["done"],
        truncated=d["truncated"],
        active=np.asarray(d["active"], dtype=bool),
    )


def check_result(d: Json) -> CheckResult:
    return CheckResult(d["method"], d["world"], d["agreement"], d["passed"])


def failure(d: Json) -> Failure:
    return Failure(d["step"], d["value"], Path(d["checkpoint"]))


def run_record(d: Json) -> RunRecord:
    return RunRecord(
        config=run_config(d["config"]),
        spec=world_spec(d["spec"]),
        started=datetime.fromisoformat(d["started"]),
        ended=None if d["ended"] is None else datetime.fromisoformat(d["ended"]),
        status=d["status"],
        failure=None if d["failure"] is None else failure(d["failure"]),
        path=Path(d["path"]),
    )


def eval_point(d: Json) -> EvalPoint:
    return EvalPoint(d["step"], dict(d["scores"]), dict(d["measures"]))


def checkpoint(d: Json) -> Checkpoint:
    return Checkpoint(
        run=d["run"],
        pct=d["pct"],
        step=d["step"],
        spec=world_spec(d["spec"]),
        methods={team: method_config(m) for team, m in d["methods"].items()},
        state={team: dict(s) for team, s in d["state"].items()},
        path=Path(d["path"]),
    )


def progress(d: Json) -> Progress:
    latest = None if d["latest"] is None else eval_point(d["latest"])
    return Progress(d["step"], d["budget"], latest, timedelta(seconds=d["elapsed"]), d["status"])


def comparison(d: Json) -> Comparison:
    return Comparison(
        baseline=d["baseline"],
        team=d["team"],
        learned_mean=d["learned_mean"],
        baseline_mean=d["baseline_mean"],
        difference=d["difference"],
        p_raw=d["p_raw"],
        p_holm=d["p_holm"],
        rejected=d["rejected"],
    )


def verdict(d: Json) -> Verdict:
    return Verdict(d["beats_baselines"], tuple(d["failing_runs"]), d["runs_needed"])


def summary(d: Json) -> Summary:
    low, high = d["learned_range"]
    return Summary(
        world=d["world"],
        variant=d["variant"],
        team=d["team"],
        runs=tuple(d["runs"]),
        learned_mean=d["learned_mean"],
        learned_range=(low, high),
        run_means=dict(d["run_means"]),
        random_mean=d["random_mean"],
        rule_mean=d["rule_mean"],
        comparisons=tuple(comparison(c) for c in d["comparisons"]),
        verdict=verdict(d["verdict"]),
        collapse=d["collapse"],
    )

"""Replay double of `core.World`: a recorded 5-step snake episode from seed 42.

The recording's spec is snake's with `max_steps` 5 (a step-limit override), so the episode ends
truncated. Actions: 0 straight, 1 turn left, 2 turn right. `reset` replays the recorded start
whatever the seed; `step` checks every action against the action format (`ActionError`, never
clipped) and replays the next recorded step, so a training loop can play it as often as it likes;
`step` after the end raises `RuntimeError`. `result()` and `draw()` give the recorded running
result and drawable state after the latest step.
"""

from typing import Any

import numpy as np

from rllab.core import (
    ActionError,
    ActionSpace,
    Array,
    Discrete,
    DrawState,
    EpisodeResult,
    Step,
    WorldSpec,
)
from tests.contracts import decode, load


def in_format(space: ActionSpace, action: Array) -> bool:
    """One agent's action inside the declared format."""
    if isinstance(space, Discrete):
        return action.ndim == 0 and float(action).is_integer() and 0 <= action < space.n
    inside = (action >= space.low) & (action <= space.high)
    return action.shape == (space.dims,) and bool(np.all(inside))


def check_actions(spec: WorldSpec, actions: Array) -> None:
    """One row per agent, each inside `spec.action`; `ActionError` naming the first that is not."""
    rows = np.asarray(actions)
    if rows.shape[:1] != (len(spec.agents),):
        raise ValueError(f"expected one action per agent ({len(spec.agents)}), got {rows.shape}")
    for agent, row in zip(spec.agents, rows, strict=True):
        if not in_format(spec.action, row):
            raise ActionError(agent, row.tolist())


class ReplayWorld:
    """Serves a recorded episode as a `core.World` (also the check-world doubles' base)."""

    def __init__(self, recording: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        self.spec = decode.world_spec(recording["spec"])
        self.seed: int = recording["seed"]
        self._entries: list[dict[str, Any]] = recording["steps"]
        self._at: int | None = None

    def reset(self, seed: int) -> Step:
        self._at = 0
        return decode.step(self._entries[0]["step"])

    def step(self, actions: Array) -> Step:
        entry = self._current()
        if entry["step"]["done"]:
            raise RuntimeError("step after the episode ended: call reset first")
        check_actions(self.spec, actions)
        self._at = (self._at or 0) + 1
        return decode.step(self._entries[self._at]["step"])

    def result(self) -> EpisodeResult:
        return decode.episode_result(self._current()["result"])

    def draw(self) -> DrawState:
        return decode.draw_state(self._current()["draw"])

    def recorded_actions(self) -> list[Array]:
        """The actions the recording took, one array per step."""
        return [decode.actions(e["actions"]) for e in self._entries[1:]]

    def _current(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if self._at is None:
            raise RuntimeError("call reset before stepping or reading the world")
        return self._entries[self._at]


def recorded_world() -> ReplayWorld:
    """The seed-42 snake episode."""
    return ReplayWorld(load.recording("core.World"))

"""Replay double of `core.Policy`: the snake rule over the 5 observations of the seed-42 episode.

`act` looks the observation up in the recording and returns the recorded actions, so it is
deterministic for a given observation and never touches the `rng`; an observation the recording
doesn't hold raises `KeyError`. Played against the `core.World` double, it replays that episode.
"""

from typing import Any

import numpy as np

from rllab.core import Array
from tests.contracts import decode, load


class ReplayPolicy:
    """Serves recorded (observation, actions) pairs as a `core.Policy`."""

    def __init__(self, calls: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
        self._table = [(decode.floats(c["obs"]), decode.actions(c["actions"])) for c in calls]

    def act(self, obs: Array, rng: np.random.Generator) -> Array:
        rows = np.asarray(obs, dtype=np.float32)
        for recorded, actions in self._table:
            if recorded.shape == rows.shape and np.array_equal(recorded, rows):
                return actions.copy()
        raise KeyError(f"observation not in the recording: {rows.tolist()}")


def recorded_policy() -> ReplayPolicy:
    """The snake rule's recorded choices."""
    return ReplayPolicy(load.recording("core.Policy")["calls"])

"""Replay doubles of `worlds.CheckWorld`: the AD-09 two-exit corridor and the 1-D target point.

Each replays its recorded episode as the `core.World` double does (`corridor.json`: from state 2,
four steps right, out of the right exit; `point.json`: from 0.6, three pushes of -1 to the
target) and serves the check world's `states()` and hand-derived `best_actions()`.
"""

from typing import Any

from rllab.core import Array
from tests.contracts import decode, load

ReplayWorld = load.module("core.World", "double").ReplayWorld


class ReplayCheckWorld(ReplayWorld):
    """A recorded check world."""

    def __init__(self, recording: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        super().__init__(recording)
        self._states = decode.floats(recording["states"])
        self._best = decode.actions(recording["best_actions"])

    def states(self) -> Array:
        return self._states.copy()

    def best_actions(self) -> Array:
        return self._best.copy()


def corridor() -> ReplayCheckWorld:
    """`check-discrete`: 6 states, action 0 = left, 1 = right."""
    return ReplayCheckWorld(load.recording("worlds.CheckWorld", "corridor"))


def point() -> ReplayCheckWorld:
    """`check-continuous`: 6 positions, one push in [-1, 1]."""
    return ReplayCheckWorld(load.recording("worlds.CheckWorld", "point"))

"""Fake of `worlds.make`: the recorded worlds, by name.

`make("snake")` returns the `core.World` double (the seed-42 snake episode); `check-discrete` and
`check-continuous` return the `worlds.CheckWorld` doubles. Any other world, variant or an override
raises `ValueError` naming it, as the real factory does for unknown names.
"""

from rllab.core import World
from tests.contracts import load

WORLDS = {
    "snake": lambda: load.module("core.World", "double").recorded_world(),
    "check-discrete": lambda: load.module("worlds.CheckWorld", "double").corridor(),
    "check-continuous": lambda: load.module("worlds.CheckWorld", "double").point(),
}


def make(world: str, variant: str = "default", **overrides: int | float) -> World:
    if world not in WORLDS:
        raise ValueError(f"unknown world {world!r}; the fake knows {sorted(WORLDS)}")
    if variant != "default":
        raise ValueError(f"unknown variant {variant!r} of {world!r}")
    if overrides:
        raise ValueError(f"the fake takes no overrides, got {sorted(overrides)}")
    return WORLDS[world]()

"""Replay double of `baselines.RandomPolicy`: recorded uniform draws for snake and one fish.

Built like the real class, from an action format: `Discrete(3)` serves `snake.json` (which
covers every observation of the `core.World` double), `Box(2, -1, 1)` serves `fish.json`. Each
observation maps to its recorded draw, every one inside the format; others raise `KeyError`.
"""

import numpy as np

from rllab.core import ActionSpace, Array, Box, Discrete
from tests.contracts import decode, load

ReplayPolicy = load.module("core.Policy", "double").ReplayPolicy
RECORDINGS = {"snake": Discrete(3), "fish": Box(2, -1.0, 1.0)}


class ReplayRandomPolicy:
    """Recorded random play for one action format."""

    def __init__(self, action: ActionSpace) -> None:
        names = [name for name, space in RECORDINGS.items() if space == action]
        if not names:
            raise KeyError(f"no recorded random play for {action}")
        recording = load.recording("baselines.RandomPolicy", names[0])
        self.action = decode.action_space(recording["action"])
        self._policy = ReplayPolicy(recording["calls"])

    def act(self, obs: Array, rng: np.random.Generator) -> Array:
        return self._policy.act(obs, rng)

"""Replay doubles of `baselines.RulePolicy`: the snake rule and the fish rule seeing no ball.

`snake_rule()` serves the SNAKE-07 choices over the seed-42 episode's observations (the four
distinct ones of the `core.World` double); `fish_rule()` serves one random fallback push for an
observation whose ball-seen flag is 0. Each carries its world's one-sentence `description`.
"""

from tests.contracts import load

ReplayPolicy = load.module("core.Policy", "double").ReplayPolicy


class ReplayRulePolicy(ReplayPolicy):
    """A recorded rule with its description."""

    def __init__(self, name: str) -> None:
        recording = load.recording("baselines.RulePolicy", name)
        super().__init__(recording["calls"])
        self.description: str = recording["description"]


def snake_rule() -> ReplayRulePolicy:
    return ReplayRulePolicy("snake")


def fish_rule() -> ReplayRulePolicy:
    return ReplayRulePolicy("fish_no_ball")

"""Replay double of `methods.Learner`: a DQN learner for snake over 10 recorded transitions.

`act` and `policy().act` serve the recorded choices for the seed-42 episode's observations (so
the learner plays the `core.World` double end to end); `observe` counts transitions and raises
`NonFiniteError` on a NaN or infinite number in one, before counting it; `state_dict()` is
`{"observed": n}`; `policy()` is a frozen copy that does not change as the learner observes.
"""

from typing import Any

import numpy as np

from rllab.core import Array, Policy
from rllab.methods import NonFiniteError, Transition
from tests.contracts import decode, load

ReplayPolicy = load.module("core.Policy", "double").ReplayPolicy


class ReplayLearner:
    """Serves a recorded learner."""

    def __init__(self, recording: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        self.method = decode.method_config(recording["method"])
        self._calls: list[dict[str, Any]] = recording["calls"]
        self._acting = ReplayPolicy(self._calls)
        self.observed = 0

    def act(self, obs: Array, rng: np.random.Generator) -> Array:
        return self._acting.act(obs, rng)

    def observe(self, t: Transition) -> None:
        values = np.concatenate([np.ravel(t.obs), np.ravel(t.rewards), np.ravel(t.next_obs)])
        bad = values[~np.isfinite(values)]
        if bad.size:
            raise NonFiniteError(float(bad[0]))
        self.observed += 1

    def policy(self) -> Policy:
        return ReplayPolicy(self._calls)

    def state_dict(self) -> dict[str, object]:
        return {"observed": self.observed}


def recorded_learner() -> ReplayLearner:
    return ReplayLearner(load.recording("methods.Learner"))


def recorded_transitions() -> list[Transition]:
    """The 10 transitions the learner was recorded over."""
    return [decode.transition(t) for t in load.recording("methods.Learner")["transitions"]]

  "content": "\"\"\"Replay double of `methods.Learner`: a DQN learner for snake over 10 recorded transitions.\n\n`act` and `policy().act` serve the recorded choices for the seed-42 episode's observations (so\nthe learner plays the `core.World` double end to end); `observe` counts transitions and raises\n`NonFiniteError` on a NaN or infinite number in one, before counting it; `state_dict()` is\n`{\"observed\": n}`; `policy()` is a frozen copy that does not change as the learner observes.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom typing import Any\n\nimport numpy as np\n\nfrom rllab.core import Array, Policy\nfrom rllab.methods import NonFiniteError, Transition\nfrom tests.contracts import decode, load\n\nReplayPolicy = load.module(\"core.Policy\", \"double\").ReplayPolicy\n\n\nclass ReplayLearner:\n    \"\"\"Serves a recorded learner.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, recording: dict[str, Any]) -> None:\n        self.method = decode.method_config(recording[\"method\"])\n        self._calls: list[dict[str, Any]] = recording[\"calls\"]\n        self._acting = ReplayPolicy(self._calls)\n        self.observed = 0\n\n    def act(self, obs: Array, rng: np.random.Generator) -> Array:\n        return self._acting.act(obs, rng)\n\n    def observe(self, t: Transition) -> None:\n        values = np.concatenate([np.ravel(t.obs), np.ravel(t.rewards), np.ravel(t.next_obs)])\n        bad = values[~np.isfinite(values)]\n        if bad.size:\n            raise NonFiniteError(float(bad[0]))\n        self.observed += 1\n\n    def policy(self) -> Policy:\n        return ReplayPolicy(self._calls)\n\n    def state_dict(self) -> dict[str, object]:\n        return {\"observed\": self.observed}\n\n\ndef recorded_learner() -> ReplayLearner:\n    return ReplayLearner(load.recording(\"methods.Learner\"))\n\n\ndef recorded_transitions() -> list[Transition]:\n    \"\"\"The 10 transitions the learner was recorded over.\"\"\"\n    return [decode.transition(t) for t in load.recording(\"methods.Learner\")[\"transitions\"]]\n"
}

"""Fake of `methods.make_learner`: the recorded DQN learner double for a `Discrete` world.

`dqn` with a `Box` action format, or `ppo` with a `Discrete` one, raises `ValueError` naming the
method and the format, as the real factory does; `ppo` with a `Box` format has no recording here
(`KeyError`).
"""

import numpy as np

from rllab.core import Discrete, MethodConfig, WorldSpec
from rllab.methods import Learner
from tests.contracts import load


def make_learner(
    config: MethodConfig, spec: WorldSpec, team: str, rng: np.random.Generator
) -> Learner:
    discrete = isinstance(spec.action, Discrete)
    if (config.method == "dqn") != discrete:
        raise ValueError(f"method {config.method!r} cannot act in the action format {spec.action}")
    if not discrete:
        raise KeyError("the fake has no recorded ppo learner")
    return load.module("methods.Learner", "double").recorded_learner()

"""Fake of `methods.load_policy`: the snake rule double for any snake checkpoint.

A checkpoint whose spec differs from the world's in observation length or action format raises
`SpecMismatchError` naming each differing field, as the real loader does; a checkpoint of another
world has no recording here (`KeyError`).
"""

from rllab.core import Policy, WorldSpec
from rllab.methods import SpecMismatchError
from rllab.runlog import Checkpoint
from tests.contracts import load


def load_policy(ckpt: Checkpoint, team: str, spec: WorldSpec) -> Policy:
    fields = tuple(f for f in ("obs_len", "action") if getattr(ckpt.spec, f) != getattr(spec, f))
    if fields:
        raise SpecMismatchError(fields)
    if ckpt.spec.world != "snake" or team != "snake":
        raise KeyError(f"the fake has no policy for team {team!r} of {ckpt.spec.world!r}")
    return load.module("baselines.RulePolicy", "double").snake_rule()

"""Replay double of `runlog.Run`: recorded 2,000-step snake run folders.

`snake-default-s1` to `-s5` are finished, each with 6 training episodes, 21 evaluation points
(steps 0, 100, ... 2,000) and checkpoints at 0%, 50% and 100%; `snake-default-s6` is incomplete
(2 episodes, 8 points, the 0% checkpoint). `run_json(name)` gives a run's JSON in the contract
shapes (what a run folder's `run.json`, `episodes.jsonl`, `evals.jsonl` and checkpoints hold).
"""

from typing import Any

from rllab.core import EpisodeResult
from rllab.runlog import Checkpoint, EvalPoint, RunRecord
from tests.contracts import decode, load


class ReplayRun:
    """A read-only recorded run folder."""

    def __init__(self, data: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        self.record: RunRecord = decode.run_record(data["record"])
        self._episodes = [decode.episode_result(e) for e in data["episodes"]]
        self._evals = [decode.eval_point(p) for p in data["evals"]]
        self._checkpoints = [decode.checkpoint(c) for c in data["checkpoints"]]

    def episodes(self) -> list[EpisodeResult]:
        return list(self._episodes)

    def evals(self) -> list[EvalPoint]:
        return list(self._evals)

    def checkpoints(self) -> list[Checkpoint]:
        return list(self._checkpoints)


def names() -> list[str]:
    """Every recorded run, finished ones first."""
    return [f"snake-default-s{run['seed']}" for run in load.recording("runlog.Run")["runs"]]


def run_json(name: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """`record`, `episodes`, `evals` and `checkpoints` of one recorded run, as contract JSON."""
    rec = load.recording("runlog.Run")
    runs = {f"snake-default-s{run['seed']}": run for run in rec["runs"]}
    if name not in runs:
        raise KeyError(f"no recorded run {name!r}; recorded: {sorted(runs)}")
    run = runs[name]
    config = {**rec["config"], "name": name, "seed": run["seed"]}
    path = f"{rec['root']}/{config['world']}/{config['variant']}/{name}"
    return {
        "record": {
            "config": config,
            "spec": rec["spec"],
            "started": rec["started"],
            "ended": run["ended"],
            "status": run["status"],
            "failure": None,
            "path": path,
        },
        "episodes": [
            {"seed": s, "length": n, "scores": {"snake": score},
             "team_rewards": {"snake": reward}, "measures": {}}
            for s, n, score, reward in run["episodes"]
        ],  # fmt: skip
        "evals": [
            {"step": i * rec["eval_every"], "scores": {"snake": score}, "measures": {}}
            for i, score in enumerate(run["evals"])
        ],
        "checkpoints": [
            {"run": name, "pct": pct, "step": step, "spec": rec["spec"],
             "methods": config["methods"], "state": {"snake": {"observed": step}},
             "path": f"{path}/checkpoints/ckpt_{pct}.pt"}
            for pct, step in run["checkpoints"]
        ],  # fmt: skip
    }


def recorded_run(name: str = "snake-default-s1") -> ReplayRun:
    return ReplayRun(run_json(name))


def finished_runs() -> list[ReplayRun]:
    """The 5 finished runs, seeds 1 to 5."""
    runs = [recorded_run(name) for name in names()]
    return [run for run in runs if run.record.status == "finished"]

"""Replay double of `runlog.RunWriter`: the writes of the finished 3-checkpoint snake run.

Built like the real class. It refuses an existing `root/<world>/<variant>/<name>` folder with
`RunExistsError` before anything else, records every call in `calls` without touching the disk,
and returns what the real writer returns: `checkpoint` the `Checkpoint` at
`<run>/checkpoints/ckpt_<pct>.pt`, `close` the `RunRecord` with the recorded start and end times.
`replay_calls()` gives the recorded writes as `(method, arguments)` pairs, in order.
"""

from collections.abc import Mapping
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from rllab.core import EpisodeResult, RunConfig, WorldSpec
from rllab.runlog import Checkpoint, EvalPoint, Failure, RunExistsError, RunRecord
from tests.contracts import load


class ReplayRunWriter:
    """Records a run's writes."""

    def __init__(self, root: Path, config: RunConfig, spec: WorldSpec) -> None:
        self.path = root / config.world / config.variant / config.name
        if self.path.exists():
            raise RunExistsError(self.path)
        rec = load.recording("runlog.RunWriter")
        self._started = datetime.fromisoformat(rec["started"])
        self._ended = datetime.fromisoformat(rec["ended"])
        self.config, self.spec = config, spec
        self.calls: list[tuple[str, Any]] = []

    def episode(self, result: EpisodeResult) -> None:
        self.calls.append(("episode", result))

    def eval(self, point: EvalPoint) -> None:
        self.calls.append(("eval", point))

    def checkpoint(self, pct: int, step: int, state: Mapping[str, dict[str, object]]) -> Checkpoint:
        self.calls.append(("checkpoint", (pct, step, state)))
        path = self.path / "checkpoints" / f"ckpt_{pct}.pt"
        return Checkpoint(self.config.name, pct, step, self.spec, self.config.methods, state, path)

    def close(self, status: str, failure: Failure | None = None) -> RunRecord:
        self.calls.append(("close", (status, failure)))
        ended = None if status == "running" else self._ended
        return RunRecord(
            self.config, self.spec, self._started, ended, status, failure, self.path
        )


def replay_calls() -> list[tuple[str, Any]]:
    """The recorded writes of `snake-default-s1`, with their arguments from the run recording."""
    rec = load.recording("runlog.RunWriter")
    run = load.module("runlog.Run", "double").recorded_run(rec["run"])
    sources = {
        "episode": run.episodes(),
        "eval": run.evals(),
        "checkpoint": [(c.pct, c.step, c.state) for c in run.checkpoints()],
    }
    return [
        ("close", (arg, None)) if method == "close" else (method, sources[method][arg])
        for method, arg in rec["calls"]
    ]

"""Fake of `runlog.find_runs`: the 5 finished snake runs, plus the incomplete one if named.

Serves the `runlog.Run` doubles whatever the root; `include=["snake-default-s6"]` adds the
incomplete run. Another world or variant has no runs.
"""

from collections.abc import Sequence
from pathlib import Path

from rllab.runlog import Run
from tests.contracts import load


def find_runs(root: Path, world: str, variant: str, *, include: Sequence[str] = ()) -> list[Run]:
    if (world, variant) != ("snake", "default"):
        return []
    double = load.module("runlog.Run", "double")
    return [
        double.recorded_run(name)
        for name in double.names()
        if double.recorded_run(name).record.status == "finished" or name in include
    ]

"""Fake of `runlog.open_run`: the recorded run named by the path's last part, any status.

`open_run(Path("runs/snake/default/snake-default-s1"))` is the finished 3-checkpoint snake run
double; a path naming no recorded run raises `FileNotFoundError`, as a folder without `run.json`.
"""

from pathlib import Path

from rllab.runlog import Run
from tests.contracts import load


def open_run(path: Path) -> Run:
    double = load.module("runlog.Run", "double")
    if path.name not in double.names():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"no run.json at {path}")

"""Fake of `runlog.find_runs`: the 5 finished snake runs, plus the incomplete one if named.

Serves the `runlog.Run` doubles whatever the root; `include=["snake-default-s6"]` adds the
incomplete run. Another world or variant has no runs.
"""

from collections.abc import Sequence
from pathlib import Path

from rllab.runlog import Run
from tests.contracts import load


def find_runs(root: Path, world: str, variant: str, *, include: Sequence[str] = ()) -> list[Run]:
    if (world, variant) != ("snake", "default"):
        return []
    double = load.module("runlog.Run", "double")
    runs = [double.recorded_run(name) for name in double.names()]
    return [r for r in runs if r.record.status == "finished" or r.record.config.name in include]

"""Fake of `train.load_run_configs`: the snake `RunConfig` sample, once per seed.

Each config is named `<file stem>-s<seed>` and carries that seed; `snake-default.toml` beside
this file is the config it stands for (method defaults filled). A missing file raises
`FileNotFoundError`, as the real loader does.
"""

from collections.abc import Sequence
from dataclasses import replace
from pathlib import Path

from rllab.core import RunConfig
from tests.contracts import decode, load

CONFIG_FILE = Path(__file__).parent / "snake-default.toml"


def load_run_configs(path: Path, seeds: Sequence[int]) -> list[RunConfig]:
    if not path.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"no config file at {path}")
    base = decode.run_config(load.sample("core.RunConfig", "snake_default"))
    return [replace(base, name=f"{path.stem}-s{seed}", seed=seed) for seed in seeds]

"""Fake of `train.run_train`: writes the recorded finished 3-checkpoint snake run folder.

For a snake config with a recorded seed (1 to 5) it writes `root/snake/default/<config name>/`
as AD-06 lays it out: `run.json` (the `RunRecord` JSON), `episodes.jsonl` and `evals.jsonl` (one
`EpisodeResult` or `EvalPoint` JSON per line) and `checkpoints/ckpt_<pct>.pt` (the `Checkpoint`
JSON without its path, through `torch.save`). It returns the finished `RunRecord`. An existing
folder raises `RunExistsError` before anything is written; another seed raises `KeyError`.
"""

import json
from pathlib import Path

import torch

from rllab.core import RunConfig
from rllab.runlog import RunExistsError, RunRecord
from tests.contracts import decode, load


def run_train(config: RunConfig, root: Path) -> RunRecord:
    folder = root / config.world / config.variant / config.name
    if folder.exists():
        raise RunExistsError(folder)
    data = load.module("runlog.Run", "double").run_json(f"snake-default-s{config.seed}")
    record = {**data["record"], "path": str(folder)}
    record["config"] = {**record["config"], "name": config.name}
    (folder / "checkpoints").mkdir(parents=True)
    (folder / "run.json").write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=1))
    for name in ("episodes", "evals"):
        lines = [json.dumps(item) + "\n" for item in data[name]]
        (folder / f"{name}.jsonl").write_text("".join(lines))
    for ckpt in data["checkpoints"]:
        saved = {key: value for key, value in ckpt.items() if key != "path"}
        torch.save({**saved, "run": config.name}, folder / "checkpoints" / f"ckpt_{ckpt['pct']}.pt")
    return decode.run_record(record)

  "content": "\"\"\"Fake of `train.run_train`: writes the recorded finished 3-checkpoint snake run folder.\n\nFor a snake config with a recorded seed (1 to 5) it writes `root/snake/default/<config name>/`\nas AD-06 lays it out: `run.json` (the `RunRecord` JSON), `episodes.jsonl` and `evals.jsonl` (one\n`EpisodeResult` or `EvalPoint` JSON per line) and `checkpoints/ckpt_<pct>.pt` (the `Checkpoint`\nJSON without its path, through `torch.save`). It returns the finished `RunRecord`. An existing\nfolder raises `RunExistsError` before anything is written; another seed raises `KeyError`.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport json\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport torch\n\nfrom rllab.core import RunConfig\nfrom rllab.runlog import RunExistsError, RunRecord\nfrom tests.contracts import decode, load\n\n\ndef run_train(config: RunConfig, root: Path) -> RunRecord:\n    folder = root / config.world / config.variant / config.name\n    if folder.exists():\n        raise RunExistsError(folder)\n    data = load.module(\"runlog.Run\", \"double\").run_json(f\"snake-default-s{config.seed}\")\n    record = {**data[\"record\"], \"path\": str(folder)}\n    record[\"config\"] = {**record[\"config\"], \"name\": config.name}\n    (folder / \"checkpoints\").mkdir(parents=True)\n    (folder / \"run.json\").write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=1))\n    for name in (\"episodes\", \"evals\"):\n        lines = [json.dumps(item) + \"\\n\" for item in data[name]]\n        (folder / f\"{name}.jsonl\").write_text(\"\".join(lines))\n    for ckpt in data[\"checkpoints\"]:\n        saved = {key: value for key, value in ckpt.items() if key != \"path\"}\n        torch.save({**saved, \"run\": config.name}, folder / \"checkpoints\" / f\"ckpt_{ckpt['pct']}.pt\")\n    return decode.run_record(record)\n"
}

"""Fake of `train.run_batch`: the recorded finished snake records, one per seed (seeds 1 to 5).

`run_batch(path, [1, 2], root)` returns the 2 finished records of `snake-default-s1` and `-s2`
without writing anything; a seed with no recorded run raises `KeyError`.
"""

from collections.abc import Sequence
from pathlib import Path

from rllab.runlog import RunRecord
from tests.contracts import load


def run_batch(
    config_path: Path,
    seeds: Sequence[int],
    root: Path,
    *,
    workers: int | None = None,
    check_seed: int = 0,
) -> list[RunRecord]:
    double = load.module("runlog.Run", "double")
    return [double.recorded_run(f"snake-default-s{seed}").record for seed in seeds]

"""Fake of `charts.learning_curve`: writes a placeholder PNG into the folder `out`.

The file is `out/curve.png` (or `out/curve-<measure>.png` for a measure), a valid 1 x 1 PNG; the
returned `Output` is a chart made from the runs' names.
"""

import base64
from collections.abc import Sequence
from pathlib import Path

from rllab.baselines import BaselineMeans
from rllab.core import Output
from rllab.runlog import Run

PLACEHOLDER_PNG = base64.b64decode(
    "iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mNkYPhfDwAChwGA60e6kgAAAABJRU5ErkJggg=="
)


def learning_curve(
    runs: Sequence[Run], baselines: BaselineMeans, out: Path, *, measure: str | None = None
) -> Output:
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path = out / ("curve.png" if measure is None else f"curve-{measure}.png")
    path.write_bytes(PLACEHOLDER_PNG)
    return Output(path, "chart", tuple(run.record.config.name for run in runs))

wrote /Users/connorott/plugins/dev-team-workspace/iteration-b1/rl9-all-at-once-A3-r1/with_skill/project/.claude/worktrees/agent-a936754240596b4a7/tests/contracts/test_samples.py
"""Every contract sample validates against its schema and builds its type; the types' invariants."""

import math
from dataclasses import replace
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pytest

from rllab.baselines import BaselineMeans
from rllab.charts import MixedRunsError
from rllab.core import (
    EVAL_SEEDS,
    FINAL_SEEDS,
    ActionError,
    Box,
    Discrete,
    DrawState,
    Episode,
    EpisodeResult,
    Frame,
    MethodConfig,
    Output,
    RunConfig,
    Step,
    TeamSpec,
    WorldSpec,
)
from rllab.evaluate import Comparison, Summary
from rllab.methods import NonFiniteError, SpecMismatchError, Transition
from rllab.runlog import Checkpoint, EvalPoint, Progress, RunExistsError, RunRecord
from rllab.train import CheckFailedError, CheckResult
from tests.contracts import decode, load, schema

TYPES = {
    "core.ActionSpace": (decode.action_space, Discrete | Box),
    "core.TeamSpec": (decode.team_spec, TeamSpec),
    "core.WorldSpec": (decode.world_spec, WorldSpec),
    "core.Step": (decode.step, Step),
    "core.EpisodeResult": (decode.episode_result, EpisodeResult),
    "core.DrawState": (decode.draw_state, DrawState),
    "core.Frame": (decode.frame, Frame),
    "core.Episode": (decode.episode, Episode),
    "core.play_episode": (decode.episode, Episode),
    "core.Output": (decode.output, Output),
    "core.MethodConfig": (decode.method_config, MethodConfig),
    "core.RunConfig": (decode.run_config, RunConfig),
    "core.EVAL_SEEDS": (decode.seeds, tuple),
    "core.FINAL_SEEDS": (decode.seeds, tuple),
    "baselines.BaselineMeans": (decode.baseline_means, BaselineMeans),
    "methods.Transition": (decode.transition, Transition),
    "train.CheckResult": (decode.check_result, CheckResult),
    "runlog.RunRecord": (decode.run_record, RunRecord),
    "runlog.EvalPoint": (decode.eval_point, EvalPoint),
    "runlog.Checkpoint": (decode.checkpoint, Checkpoint),
    "runlog.Progress": (decode.progress, Progress),
    "evaluate.Comparison": (decode.comparison, Comparison),
    "evaluate.Summary": (decode.summary, Summary),
}
SAMPLES = [
    (symbol, path)
    for symbol in TYPES
    for path in sorted((load.folder(symbol) / "samples").glob("*.json"))
]


def sample_id(case: tuple[str, Path]) -> str:
    return f"{case[0]}/{case[1].stem}"


def test_every_schema_folder_is_checked_and_has_a_sample():
    on_disk = {path.parent.name for path in load.CONTRACTS.glob("*/schema.json")}
    assert on_disk == set(TYPES)
    assert all(load.samples(symbol) for symbol in TYPES)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("case", SAMPLES, ids=sample_id)
def test_sample_validates_against_its_schema(case):
    symbol, path = case
    assert schema.errors(load.read(path), load.folder(symbol) / "schema.json") == []


@pytest.mark.parametrize("case", SAMPLES, ids=sample_id)
def test_sample_builds_its_type(case):
    symbol, path = case
    build, kind = TYPES[symbol]
    assert isinstance(build(load.read(path)), kind)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ the schemas reject bad JSON
def errors_for(symbol: str, value: object) -> list[str]:
    return schema.errors(value, load.folder(symbol) / "schema.json")


def test_schema_rejects_a_missing_field():
    spec = load.sample("core.WorldSpec", "snake_default")
    del spec["obs_len"]
    assert errors_for("core.WorldSpec", spec) == ["$: missing 'obs_len'"]


def test_schema_rejects_an_unexpected_field_and_a_wrong_type():
    result = {**load.sample("train.CheckResult", "dqn_pass"), "passed": "yes", "note": 1}
    found = errors_for("train.CheckResult", result)
    assert "$: unexpected 'note'" in found
    assert any(line.startswith("$.passed:") for line in found)


def test_schema_rejects_a_boolean_where_a_number_belongs():
    point = {**load.sample("runlog.EvalPoint", "snake_50pct"), "scores": {"snake": True}}
    assert errors_for("runlog.EvalPoint", point) == ["$.scores.snake: True is not number"]


def test_schema_rejects_values_outside_the_contract():
    ckpt = {**load.sample("runlog.Checkpoint", "snake_0pct"), "pct": 5}
    assert errors_for("runlog.Checkpoint", ckpt)
    action = {"kind": "discrete", "n": 0}
    assert errors_for("core.ActionSpace", action) == ["$: matches no anyOf"]
    seeds = [*load.sample("core.EVAL_SEEDS", "seeds"), 1_000_020]
    assert len(errors_for("core.EVAL_SEEDS", seeds)) == 2  # one too many, one out of range


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ seed sets
def test_seed_samples_are_the_core_seed_sets():
    assert decode.seeds(load.sample("core.EVAL_SEEDS", "seeds")) == EVAL_SEEDS
    assert decode.seeds(load.sample("core.FINAL_SEEDS", "seeds")) == FINAL_SEEDS


def test_seed_sets_are_disjoint_from_training_seeds_and_each_other():
    assert (len(EVAL_SEEDS), len(FINAL_SEEDS)) == (20, 100)
    assert min(EVAL_SEEDS + FINAL_SEEDS) >= 1_000_000
    assert not set(EVAL_SEEDS) & set(FINAL_SEEDS)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ invariants the types enforce
def test_action_spaces_refuse_empty_formats():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="n >= 1"):
        Discrete(0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="low < high"):
        Box(2, 1.0, -1.0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="dims >= 1"):
        Box(0, -1.0, 1.0)


def test_checkpoint_pct_is_a_multiple_of_ten():
    ckpt = decode.checkpoint(load.sample("runlog.Checkpoint", "snake_100pct"))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="pct"):
        replace(ckpt, pct=5)


def test_check_result_passes_at_95_percent_agreement():
    assert CheckResult("dqn", "check-discrete", 0.95, passed=True).passed
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="agreement"):
        CheckResult("dqn", "check-discrete", 0.94, passed=True)


def test_errors_name_their_cause():
    action = ActionError("snake", 3)
    assert isinstance(action, ValueError)
    assert (action.agent, action.value) == ("snake", 3)
    mismatch = SpecMismatchError(("obs_len", "action"))
    assert isinstance(mismatch, ValueError)
    assert "obs_len, action" in str(mismatch)
    assert math.isnan(NonFiniteError(float("nan")).value)
    exists = RunExistsError(Path("runs/snake/default/dup"))
    assert isinstance(exists, FileExistsError)
    assert "runs/snake/default/dup" in str(exists)
    failed = decode.check_result(load.sample("train.CheckResult", "ppo_fail"))
    assert CheckFailedError(failed).result is failed
    assert "80%" in str(CheckFailedError(failed))
    assert MixedRunsError(("budget",)).settings == ("budget",)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ samples agree with the contract
def test_step_samples_have_one_row_per_agent_and_zero_rows_for_inactive_agents():
    for data in load.samples("core.Step").values():
        step = decode.step(data)
        assert step.obs.dtype == np.float32
        assert len(step.obs) == len(step.rewards) == len(step.active)
        assert not step.obs[~step.active].any()
        assert not step.rewards[~step.active].any()


def test_traced_episode_samples_have_length_plus_one_frames():
    traced = [load.sample("core.Episode", "check_traced_3_steps")]
    traced.append(load.sample("core.play_episode", "snake_rule_seed7_traced"))
    for data in traced:
        episode = decode.episode(data)
        assert episode.frames is not None
        assert len(episode.frames) == episode.result.length + 1
        assert [f.step for f in episode.frames] == list(range(episode.result.length + 1))
        assert dict(episode.frames[-1].scores) == dict(episode.result.scores)


def test_frame_samples_are_the_first_frames_of_the_seed7_episode():
    episode = decode.episode(load.sample("core.play_episode", "snake_rule_seed7_traced"))
    assert episode.frames is not None
    for i, case in enumerate(["snake_seed7_frame0", "snake_seed7_frame1"]):
        frame = decode.frame(load.sample("core.Frame", case))
        assert frame.draw == episode.frames[i].draw
        assert frame.step == i


def test_world_spec_teams_are_disjoint_and_cover_every_agent():
    for data in load.samples("core.WorldSpec").values():
        spec = decode.world_spec(data)
        agents = [a for team in spec.teams for a in team.agents]
        assert sorted(agents) == list(range(len(spec.agents)))


def test_run_samples_hold_full_method_settings():
    defaults = decode.method_config(load.sample("core.MethodConfig", "snake_dqn_defaults"))
    spec = decode.world_spec(load.sample("core.WorldSpec", "snake_default"))
    record = decode.run_record(load.sample("runlog.RunRecord", "snake_finished"))
    ckpt = decode.checkpoint(load.sample("runlog.Checkpoint", "snake_100pct"))
    assert record.config.methods == {"snake": defaults} == ckpt.methods
    assert record.spec == spec == ckpt.spec
    failed = decode.run_record(load.sample("runlog.RunRecord", "failed_nan"))
    assert failed.failure is not None
    assert math.isnan(failed.failure.value)


def test_summary_samples_agree_with_their_run_means():
    for data in load.samples("evaluate.Summary").values():
        summary = decode.summary(data)
        means = list(summary.run_means.values())
        assert summary.learned_mean == pytest.approx(sum(means) / len(means), abs=1e-12)
        assert summary.learned_range == (min(means), max(means))
        assert summary.runs == tuple(summary.run_means)
    few = decode.summary(load.sample("evaluate.Summary", "snake_3_runs"))
    assert (few.comparisons, few.verdict.runs_needed) == ((), 2)
